items.title: Xbox Game Pass’ November 2026 Wave 2 Adds Hela: Of Mice & Magic, Outlast Trials and More
items.summary: Xbox Game Pass’ November 2026 Wave 2 is here, and brings Hela: Of Mice & Magic, Outlast Trials, , Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 and more to the service.
items.content:
Game Pass News PC Xbox Jon "Sikamikanico" Clarke

Xbox Game Pass’ November 2026 Wave 2 is here, and brings Hela: Of Mice & Magic, Outlast Trials, Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 and more to the service. Let’s take a look.

Xbox Game Pass has a handful of new games to add to your backlog. Here is each title coming to Game Pass Ultimate, when they hit the service, and which platforms they will be available on, thank to the folks over on Xbox Wire .

Paw Patrol: Dino World (Cloud, Console, and PC) Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, PC Game Pass

Call of the Elder Gods (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 18 Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass

High on Life 2 (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 18 Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass

Roadside Research (Game Preview) (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 18 Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass

Black Jacket (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 19 Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass

Motorslice (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 24 Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass

Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 (Cloud, Console, Handheld, and PC) – November 24 Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, PC Game Pass

Arkheron (Game Preview) (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, and PC) – November 27 Game Pass Ultimate, PC Game Pass

Available on day one with XBOX Game Pass! Enter Arkheron , a fast-paced PvP action game where teams of three scale a mysterious Tower. Items are the heroes – imbued with abilities that define your strategy. Loot, adapt, and strategize your playstyle on the fly. Every decision alters how you fight and who you become. Ascension awaits.

The Outlast Trials (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, and PC) – December 1 Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, PC Game Pass

Hela: of Mice & Magic (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, and PC) – December 1 Game Pass Ultimate, PC Game Pass

items.title: XBOX Game Pass November 2026 Wave 2 Lineup
items.summary: XBOX Game Pass adds 10 games from November 17 to December 1, including The Outlast Trials, Arkheron, and five Game Pass Premium expansions.
items.content:
XBOX Game Pass adds 10 games from November 17 to December 1, including The Outlast Trials, Arkheron, and five Game Pass Premium expansions.

This post may contain affiliate links. If you wish to support us and use these links to buy something, we may earn a commission. Our disclosures explain more. You can also support us by making us a Preferred Source on Google or wishlisting our game, Better Luck Next Run , on Steam!

Leaving November 30 XBOX Game Pass November 2026 Wave 2 Lineup Half of the 10 games in XBOX’s second Game Pass roundup for November are titles that subscribers on the higher tiers have had access to for months. Five are day one releases from earlier this year that are now expanding to Game Pass Premium, including High on Life 2 and Call of the Elder Gods. The wave runs from November 17 to December 1 and also has two new day one releases, Arkheron and Hela: of Mice & Magic, along with The Outlast Trials and Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2. XBOX also included Paw Patrol: Dino World in today’s announcement, though it was already part of the first wave that announced 15 games earlier this month.

Available today is Paw Patrol: Dino World on Cloud, Console, and PC for Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, and PC Game Pass subscribers. It’s an action adventure set on Dino Island, where the pups rescue dinosaurs and use their unique skills to get past obstacles while putting a stop to Mayor Humdinger’s chaos. The adventure can be played solo or with a friend in two-player co-op.

November 18 brings three games to Game Pass Premium, and all of them have been on Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass since launching as day one releases. Call of the Elder Gods arrived in May’s first wave , and it’s a Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure from Out of the Blue Games that serves as the sequel to 2020’s Call of the Sea, sending players to the far corners of the Earth. High on Life 2 was a day one release in February’s first wave , with Squanch Games bringing back its talking alien guns for a sequel that has players shooting, stabbing, and skating across the galaxy to stop an intergalactic conspiracy.

The third game on November 18 is Roadside Research , which is still in Game Preview after joining the service on February 12. It’s a co-op gas station simulator for up to four players who are secretly aliens, scanning and testing customers to gather data on humans without raising the suspicion meter high enough to get a visit from government officials. When it was announced for Game Pass in February, I said the trailer reminded me of Schedule I and Abiotic Factor, and that we’d probably check it out as a group. All three November 18 additions will be available on Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC.

Black Jacket follows on November 19 on the same platforms, expanding to Game Pass Premium six months after it launched alongside Call of the Elder Gods on May 12. Developed by Mi’pu’mi Games and published by Skystone Games, it’s a blackjack-inspired game set in purgatory, where restless souls wager their coins and cheating is encouraged. The last of the Premium expansions is Motorslice on November 24, also on Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC. It launched on May 5 as a day one release for Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass, and it has players parkouring through the ruins of a brutalist megastructure as a slicer named P, climbing massive bosses and hunting down living construction equipment.

Also on November 24, Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 joins on Cloud, Console, Handheld, and PC for all three tiers. It’s a modern warfare shooter set in the Middle East, with players taking on the role of Raven, a contract sniper assassin working through a series of targets in a single-player campaign. XBOX Wire describes it as the most challenging entry in the series, with extreme-range shots exceeding 1,000 meters.

Arkheron is the first of two new day one releases in this wave, entering Game Preview on November 27 on Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, and PC for Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass subscribers. It comes from Bonfire Studios, a team founded by former Blizzard developers who worked on Diablo, Overwatch, StarCraft, and World of Warcraft. Arkheron is a fast-paced PvP action game where teams of three scale a mysterious Tower, and instead of choosing heroes, players build their abilities from the items they loot along the way.

December 1 closes out the wave with two more games, starting with The Outlast Trials on Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, and PC for all three tiers. PlayStation Plus subscribers got this one as part of the Monthly Games lineup last December , and it has players recruited by the Murkoff Corporation as human guinea pigs for brainwashing and mind control experiments, either alone or with friends. The other is Hela: of Mice & Magic , a day one release for Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass subscribers on the same platforms. Developed by Windup Games and published by Knights Peak, it’s a 3D co-op adventure starring a brave little mouse in landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, with puzzles to solve along the way.

Beyond the new games, subscribers are also getting two in-game benefits on December 1. World of Tanks Blitz has a monthly bonus on PC for every tier, including Game Pass Essential, while World of Tanks Modern Armor has an XP Stock bundle on console for Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, and Game Pass Essential. The Modern Armor bundle includes three days of Premium Account, six x4 Commander XP Boosters, and six x3 Vehicle XP Boosters.

Eight games leave the XBOX Game Pass library on November 30, and eligible members can save up to 20 percent on select titles before they go. The list includes Aliens: Dark Descent, Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden, Generation Zero, Moving Out 2, and Star Trucker.

Multiplatform subscribers can also check out this month’s PlayStation Plus Game Catalog additions and the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for November 2026 . Anything that arrived earlier in the month is covered in the first November wave .

Thanks for signing up. Look for an email from Substack at .

items.title: Coming to XBOX Game Pass: Hela: of Mice & Magic, The Outlast Trials, Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2, and More
items.summary: Gather around, gamers! We’ve got more games coming your way, and there’s a little something for everyone. In the mood for a little magic? Terrifying Gather around, gamers! We’ve got more games coming your way. Hela: of Mice & Magic, The Outlast Trials, Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2, and more coming soon to Game Pass!
items.content:
Gather around, gamers! We’ve got more games coming your way, and there’s a little something for everyone. In the mood for a little magic? Terrifying trials? High-stakes sniper missions? We’ve got it all. So, let’s get right into the games!

Paw Patrol: Dino World (Cloud, Console, and PC) Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, PC Game Pass

Embark on a dino-sized action adventure in Paw Patrol Dino World ! Explore Dino Island, rescue dinosaurs, overcome obstacles using the Pups’ unique skills and put a stop to Mayor Humdinger’s chaos. Take on the adventure solo or team up with a friend in two-player co-op.

Call of the Elder Gods (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 18 Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass

Journey to the far corners of the Earth and unearth ancient horrors in this Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure and sequel to 2020’s critically acclaimed Call of the Sea .

High on Life 2 (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 18 Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass

An intergalactic conspiracy threatens the fate of humanity! Team up with a wide cast of talking alien guns as you shoot, stab, and skate your way through exotic locales across the galaxy to take down the bad guys and save your favorite species (humans)!

Roadside Research (Game Preview) (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 18 Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass

Aliens have landed on Earth… to run a gas station. Play solo or up to 4 players doing human tasks to blend in. Scan, steal, and test various methods on customers while they stop by the gas station. Gather all data you can from humans without raising the suspicion meter too high, risk a visit from government officials.

Black Jacket (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 19 Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass

21 or eternity? Black Jacket drops you into a purgatorial card game where restless souls wager their coins, and the ferryman waits for his cut. From Mi’pu’mi Games and Skystone Games ( Tiny Bookshop ) — a painterly, pitch-black spin on blackjack awaits. Cheating fully encouraged.

Motorslice (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 24 Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass

Play as the skilled (but seemingly ever-sleepy) slicer, P, and parkour through the ruins of a brutalist megastructure, climb massive bosses, and hunt down every piece of living construction equipment in this slice of life action-adventure with immaculate vibes.

Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 (Cloud, Console, Handheld, and PC) – November 24 Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, PC Game Pass

items.title: New Update | Geister Limited-Time Event, Community Event, MK-Challenges & More
items.summary: Greetings Reagents Freedom is within reach... Or so we’re led to believe. The Season 7.2 Update for The Outlast Trials is live! Help Amelia in the ESCAPE THE FACILITY Community Event , return to the madness of the GEISTER Program , and take
items.content:
Greetings Reagents

Freedom is within reach... Or so we’re led to believe. The Season 7.2 Update for The Outlast Trials is live! Help Amelia in the ESCAPE THE FACILITY Community Event, return to the madness of the GEISTER Program, and take on two new MK-Challenges. Plus, test your limits with revamped Escalation Therapy, personalize your look with the new Favorites feature, and more.

This update includes 

  • Geister Limited-Time Event is back!

    [/*]

  • New Geister Catalog

    [/*]

  • Geister 2025 Catalog Available in Murkoff Store

    [/*]

  • New Community Event: ESCAPE THE FACILITY 

    [/*]

  • New MK-Challenge: COMPEL THE CHILDREN

    [/*]

  • New MK-Challenge: SANITIZE THE FACTORY

    [/*]

  • Escalation Therapy Changes

    [/*]

  • Favorites Feature

    [/*]

  • Black Market Sale

    [/*]

GEISTER Limited-Time Event

Program "Geister" is an experiment in convergent hallucinatory therapy designed to amplify unforeseen side effects of the Trials. 

Surviving subjects will learn to contribute to a morally hygienic Trial Environment through biohazard collection. Complete the secondary objective for extra rewards. 

Variators: 

  • HARVEST ORGAN SAMPLES - Find deceased reagents and harvest organ samples for analysis. 

    [/*]

  • HALLUCINATIONS? - Side effect, trauma or something else? 

    [/*]

  • MORE IMPOSTERS - More imposters in the Trial. 

    [/*]

GEISTER CATALOG

  • A brand new Catalog is available for the duration of the Limited-Time Event. 

    [/*]

  • Players can spend their acquired Event Tokens in the Catalog to unlock exclusive rewards. 

    [/*]

  • Once the event concludes, the Catalog will be removed and any unused Event Tokens will be forfeited. Be sure to spend your Event Tokens before the end of the event on December 8 at 10am ET.

    [/*]

New Community Event: ESCAPE THE FACILITY

"We need your help.

Find as much escape intel as possible, and make sure to leave the Trial with it. 

We need everyone onboard to make the escape possible this time. 

We're all getting out! - A”

Help Amelia! Reagents must find Escape Intel Schematics and leave the Trials with them in their inventory. Every phase of the Community Event unlocks exclusive rewards for participating Reagents. Reaching each milestone phase will get you one step closer to the possibility of Escape.

New MK-Challenge: COMPEL THE CHILDREN

You are the gentle prayer, the shame ingested and repeated until it feels like your own, and becomes a vector of further infection. Pray for the children, and we will let you out. 

This MK-Challenge will be featured in Phase 1 of the Geister Program and is avaialable in GENESIS.

New MK-Challenge: SANITIZE THE FACTORY

You are the rain, a drop in the flood that will nourish the earth, drown the wicked, and cleanse the filth. Sanitize the factory and we will let you out.

This MK-Challenge will be featured in Phase 2 of the Geister Program and is available in GENESIS.

Escalation Therapy Changes

  • Rebalanced the difficulty curve of Escalation Therapy for a smoother progression: 

    • Tier 1 (Trials #1–20): Build your character. 

      [/*]

    • Tier 2 (Trials #21–30): Put your character to the test. 

      [/*]

    • Tier 3 (Trials #31+): Enter the endgame. 

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Added a new permanent Variator starting at Trial #31: 

    • BREAKING POINT. A collection of punishing modifiers. Deadly enemies. Scarce resources. No second chances. Rigs don't recharge. And more. Push your mental and physical limits. 

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Revive Syringes and Revive Pills can now be acquired during Intermission item selection. 

    [/*]

  • Retouched several Escalation Therapy Tasks to better align with the new progression. 

    [/*]

Favorites Feature

You can now mark any customization item as a favorite. Use the Favorites filter in both your Cell Customization and Reagent Customization Menus to quickly find and equip your preferred items. Now you can easily assemble your preferred outfits for any occasion. 

Black Market Sale

The Murkoff Black Market is offering Reagents 50% off selected Legendary Outfits from now until November 3rd. Check out the in-game store to see if any behavioral attire catches your eye!

Additions/Fixes/Balancing 

  • The “Geister 2025” Catalog is now available for purchase in the Murkoff Store. 

    [/*]

  • Added new Weeklies to the Weekly Escalation pool. 

    [/*]

  • Reagent customization is now preserved after Relapses, except after the first Relapse. 

    [/*]

  • Lock Breaker Amp: Bricks now break instantly after unlocking a padlocked container or door. 

    [/*]

  • Reagents can now look behind them while assisting teammates in the Incapacitated or Dead state. 

    [/*]

  • Added a setting to enable or disable the new controller minigame feature. 

    [/*]

  • Trials adjustments: 

    • Fund the Campaign: Reworked the escape phase difficulty and exit timer based on objective completion. 

      [/*]

    • Eliminate the Past: Reworked the escape phase difficulty and exit timer based on objective completion. 

      [/*]

    • Battery Stations no longer count as light areas for player detection. 

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Other general fixes and improvements. 

    [/*]

As always, we want to hear from you! Let us know what you think of The Outlast Trials through our feedback form. If you happen to encounter any issues while playing, please join our 18+ Official Outlast Discord Server and create a ticket to speak directly with our support team.

Remember, we are all getting better together, and we will see you in the Sleep Room, Reagents!

The RB Team

items.title: New Update | Chemical Leak Limited-Time Event, 2 New MK-Challenges & more
items.summary: Greetings Reagents, Reagents, hold your breath! Murkoff is releasing toxic gas into the Trials with the new Chemical Leak Limited-Time Event , featuring a new exclusive Limited-Time Chemical Leak Catalog . This update also brings 2 new MK-C
items.content:
Greetings Reagents,

Reagents, hold your breath! Murkoff is releasing toxic gas into the Trials with the new Chemical Leak Limited-Time Event, featuring a new exclusive Limited-Time Chemical Leak Catalog. This update also brings 2 new MK-Challenges, a new round of improvements and balancing updates to Invasion and Escalation, along with new quality-of-life options and other changes to the Therapy experience. Let's see how well you endure the fumes and survive the Therapy!

This update includes

  • New Limited-Time Event: CHEMICAL LEAK

    [/*]

  • New Limited-Time Catalog: CHEMICAL LEAK

    [/*]

  • New MK-Challenge: CHANGE THE PROGRAM

    [/*]

  • New MK-Challenge: FUND THE CAMPAIGN

    [/*]

  • Various bug fixes and improvements.

    [/*]

New Limited-Time Event: CHEMICAL LEAK

Poison is an intoxicating embrace that suffocates the body, just as false idols poison the beliefs of the weak, uneducated, and vulnerable. Shut off the valves, breathe freely, and remember that therapy is the only answer.

Variators:

  • CHEMICAL LEAK -A chemical leak is filling the Trial with toxic gas. Find the valves to clear the gas from each area.

    [/*]

  • SHUT OFF THE VALVES - Shut off the valves in the Trial to stop the chemical leaks.

    [/*]

The event runs from Tuesday Sept. 8 (10AM ET) until Tuesday Oct. 6 (10AM ET).

New Limited-Time Catalog: CHEMICAL LEAK

  • A brand new Catalog is available for the duration of the Chemical Leak Limited-Time Event.

    [/*]

  • Players can spend their acquired Event Tokens in the Catalog to unlock exclusive rewards.

    [/*]

  • Once the Chemical Leak Event concludes, the Catalog will be removed and any unused Event Tokens will be forfeited. Be sure to spend your Event Tokens before the end of the event on Tuesday Oct. 6 (10AM ET).

    [/*]

New MK-Challenge: CHANGE THE PROGRAM

You are the crier, who knows that news does not have to be journalism, it only has to be new. Spread our truth, change the program, and we will let you out. 

New MK-Challenge: FUND THE CAMPAIGN

You are the hammer in the hands of a child, to shatter the fragile swine who would separate success from the government it created. Money is the future of speech. Fund the campaign and we will let you out.

Additions/Fixes/Balancing

Invasion

  • Evasive Manoeuvre: Now counters Backstabs by triggering a STRUGGLE instead, and win STRUGGLES more easily against Imposters.

    [/*]

  • Neuroshock: Now automatically pinged when thrown on the ground.

    [/*]

  • During the Exit Phase: When a Reagent is revived, an Imposter will spawn from a closet to match the new number of living Reagents.

    [/*]

  • Ex-Pops and Prime Assets will no longer target Reagents immediately after a Stab or Backstab.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where the Steel Trap deployment audio could be heard from a very long distance.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where players could body block other players (You can now push past a player of the opposing role who is blocking your path by walking into them for half a second.)

    [/*]

Escalation

  • Removed Broken Reagent from the variators pool.

    [/*]

  • Improved Escalation run stability to reduce server disconnections.

    [/*]

  • Players can now restore their save after a disconnection or crash.

    [/*]

  • Escalation Trial #21 and above: Damage is permanent throughout the run, and Revives are no longer available, making higher-level Trials even more challenging.

    [/*]

General

  • Improved online stability, including rubberbanding, lag, and disconnections. We will continue monitoring performance and making improvements as needed.

    [/*]

  • Player loadouts are now displayed in the Pause Menu.

    [/*]

  • Rebirth: Loadouts are no longer reset after completing a Rebirth.

    [/*]

  • Reworked Biter speed and aggressiveness, and slightly increased its chance of breaking the chain.

    [/*]

  • Slightly increased Kress Twins chase speed.

    [/*]

  • Slightly reduced Arora throw cooldown.

    [/*]

  • Fixed the price of the Jammer Rig skin in the Project Boneyard Catalog. It now costs 30 (was 75).

    [/*]

  • Fixed the rarity of the Project Boneyard poster. It is now Classified (was Basic).

    [/*]

  • Fixed the numbering of the Hopscotch floor game in the Orphanage, making it playable again.

    [/*]

  • Mods support is no longer available. While we recognize that mods can offer useful customization, some can provide gameplay advantages or alter the game in unintended ways. To maintain a fair and consistent experience for everyone across all game modes, mods are no longer supported.

    [/*]

  • We’ve added several new options to the Settings menu, including quality of life features that were previously available through mods. These are now built directly into the game and available to everyone:

    • Field of View — Slider

      [/*]

    • Camera Shake — Slider

      [/*]

    • Motion Blur — On / Off

      [/*]

    • Film Grain — On / Off

      [/*]

    • Chromatic Aberration — On / Off

      [/*]

    • Lens Flares — On / Off

      [/*]

    • Vignette — On / Off

      [/*]

    • Bloom — On / Off

      [/*]

    • Startup videos — On / Off

      [/*]

    • Toggle HUD Display — On / Off

      [/*]
    [/*]

We’d love to hear what other quality-of-life features you’d like to see added to the game. Please share your suggestions through our feedback form.

If you encounter any issues in-game, feel free to join our 18+ Official Outlast Discord Server and create a ticket to speak directly with our support team.

Catch you in the Sleep Room, Reagents!

The RB Team

items.title: Roadmap & Season 7.1 Dev Blog | Update Coming Sept. 8
items.summary: Greetings Reagents, September has hit, and as we near the Season 7.1 update, we wanted to let you know some of what’s coming for this most recent update on September 8th at 10am ET and for the rest of the year in The Outlast Trials! Roadmap
items.content:
Greetings Reagents,

September has hit, and as we near the Season 7.1 update, we wanted to let you know some of what’s coming for this most recent update on September 8th at 10am ET and for the rest of the year in The Outlast Trials!

Roadmap

The Therapy isn’t slowing down. Here’s a look at what’s coming to The Outlast Trials through the end of 2026. 👁️

Season 7.1 – Coming September 8th 

This update will feature 2 new MK-Challenges and a new Limited-Time Event: Chemical Leak.

New Limited-Time Event: CHEMICAL LEAK

Poison is an intoxicating embrace that suffocates the body, just as false idols poison the beliefs of the weak, uneducated, and vulnerable. Shut off the valves, breathe freely, and remember that therapy is the only answer. This event will also feature its own exclusive Catalog.

New MK-Challenge: CHANGE THE PROGRAM

You are the crier, who knows that news does not have to be journalism, it only has to be new. Spread our truth, change the program, and we will let you out.

New MK-Challenge: FUND THE CAMPAIGN

You are the hammer in the hands of a child, to shatter the fragile swine who would separate success from the government it created. Money is the future of speech. Fund the campaign and we will let you out.

End of Mod Support as of Season 7.1

Starting September 8 with the Season 7.1 update mod support is no longer available. While we recognize that mods can offer useful customization, some can provide gameplay advantages or alter the game in unintended ways. To maintain a fair and consistent experience for everyone across all game modes, mods are no longer supported.

We’ve added several new options to the Settings menu, including quality of life features that were previously available through mods. These are now built directly into the game and available to everyone:

  • Field of View – Slider

    [/*]

  • Camera Shake – Slider

    [/*]

  • Motion Blur – On / Off

    [/*]

  • Film Grain – On / Off

    [/*]

  • Chromatic Aberration – On / Off

    [/*]

  • Lens Flares – On / Off

    [/*]

  • Vignette – On / Off

    [/*]

  • Bloom – On / Off

    [/*]

  • Startup videos – On / Off

    [/*]

  • Toggle HUD Display – On / Off

    [/*]

We will be opening a new general feedback form to continue to monitor our Reagents quality of life and see what other features we can try to add in-game!

Outlast Anniversary Merch Out Now!

It was 13 years ago today when we first entered Mount Massive and faced Chris Walker. Now you can wear a piece of our unforgettable Outlast villain wherever you go! Check out the new Outlast Anniversary Collection:

https://store.redbarrelsgames.com/collections/outlast-collection

We are excited to see you all in the Sinyala Facility very soon!

Team RB

items.content:
Greetings Reagents,

Our team has deployed a new hotfix patch to address the following issues:

  • Improved disconnection issues in Escalation runs.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where Imposters would not receive a rank when leaving an Invasion early using “Exit Invasion” from the Pause Menu.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where the Struggle minigame would not appear if a Reagent was grabbed by an NPC while entering a Steel Trap.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where a television screen was missing a code location hint in the MK-Challenge “Cancel the Broadcast”.

    [/*]

INVASION CHANGES

  • Stab/Backstab: Increased charge time to 2.5s (was 2.0s).

    [/*]

  • Backstab: Reduced the Backstab angle, requiring Imposters to be more directly behind their target.

    [/*]

  • Backstab: Now incapacitates the Reagent instead of killing them instantly.

    [/*]

  • Slash: Increased cooldown to 2.0s (was 1.5s).

    [/*]

  • Steel Trap: Reduced mash time required to escape.

    [/*]

  • Steel Trap: Reduced trigger radius.

    [/*]

  • Steel Trap: Reduced damage to 12.5 (was 25), allowing Reagents to regenerate health after escaping.

    [/*]

  • Imposter Night Vision: Reworked the visual effect while preserving its reduced effectiveness in darkness.

    [/*]

  • Imposter Night Vision: Increased battery duration.

    [/*]

  • Imposter Respawn: Increased the minimum camera time of Imposters to 45s when against a solo Reagent (was 30s).

    [/*]

  • Solo Invasion: Reduced active Invasion time to 3 minutes (was 5 minutes).

    [/*]

  • Stim: Slightly increased injection time to reduce reactive use during encounters.

    [/*]

  • Syringes now spawn throughout the Trial instead of being limited in quantity.

    [/*]

  • Reagents can now use the Regroup button even while Imposters are present in the room.

    [/*]

Remember that if you encounter any issues in-game, please join our 18+ Official Outlast Discord Server and create a ticket to speak with our support team directly.

Thank you to everyone who has been filling out our Invasion 2.0 Feedback Survey. Your feedback will help us keep refining this game mode. We're also still gathering feedback for the Season 6: Project Judas update, so let us know what you thought about last Season's Therapy.

Catch you in the Sleep Room Reagents!

items.title: Project Boneyard Patch Notes | Season 7: New Coyle Trial, New MKs, & much more!
items.summary: Greetings Reagents! The time has come for punishment! Reagents must join together to face Coyle in his all new Trial environment: The Prison Farm. The update also introduces 2 new MK-Challenges, many new features, including Rig Customizatio
items.content:
Greetings Reagents!

The time has come for punishment! Reagents must join together to face Coyle in his all new Trial environment: The Prison Farm.

The update also introduces 2 new MK-Challenges, many new features, including Rig Customization, Knife Customization, Loadout Presets, and Mastery Tasks, alongside major reworks to both Escalation and Invasion that significantly improve the overall experience.

This Update Includes

  • Season 7: PROJECT BONEYARD

    [/*]

  • New Trial Environment: PRISON FARM

    [/*]

  • New Trial: LOCKSOCK THE WARDEN

    [/*]

  • New MK-Challenge: BRIBE THE JUDGES

    [/*]

  • New MK-Challenge: CANCEL THE BROADCAST

    [/*]

  • New Deluxe Catalog: PROJECT BONEYARD

    [/*]

  • Introducing Community Event: BLOOD DRIVE

    [/*]

  • New Limited-Time Catalog: BLOOD DRIVE

    [/*]

  • New Ex-Pop: THE BITER

    [/*]

  • New Reagent Rig & Knife Customizations

    [/*]

  • New Loadout Presets

    [/*]

  • New Mastery Tasks

    [/*]

  • New Hint System

    [/*]

  • Escalation Therapy 2.0

    [/*]

  • Invasion 2.0

    [/*]

  • New Invasion Season

    [/*]

  • New Blackmarket Outfits

    [/*]

  • New Twitch Drops

    [/*]

  • Other Additions, Improvements, and Fixes

    [/*]

SEASON 7: PROJECT BONEYARD

Project Boneyard sees the introductions of our latest Trial environment, The Prison Farm, and the return of Sergeant Leland Coyle in a new Trial, “Locksock the Warden.” Reagents will bring “cruel and unusual” back to the living conditions of the prison population until riot makes way for revenge, while avoiding the latest member of our experimental population: The Biter.

Murkoff is also premiering “Bribe the Judges” and “Cancel the Broadcast,” two new MK-Challenges added to the roster of available therapies.

Reagents will also discover new machinery installed across various Trials in support of the new Blood Drive event. The Reagent community is strongly advised to donate their blood for \.

New Trial Environment: PRISON FARM

The American prison complex; a meat grinder that takes in sociopaths and criminals and extrudes functioning members of society. But the strict routine, severe conditioning, and close quarters serve as a crucible for power dynamics built on violence, contraband, and flesh. Turn yourself in and suffer rehabilitation.

New Trial: LOCKSOCK THE WARDEN

You are freedom. The indefinable promise that keeps prisoners at the grindstone that turns authority to profit and back again. Don't let false authority stand in the way of real capital. Kill the Warden, and we will let you out.

New MK-Challenge: BRIBE THE JUDGES

You are the master, whose property is the purpose of the law. Salary reminds enforcement that their monopoly of violence only exists for your monopoly of capital. Collect the bribes, pay the judges, and we will let you out.

New MK-Challenge: CANCEL THE BROADCAST

You are the butcher, who reminds the sheep the ultimate path of all flesh, no matter the bounty of wealth or the wealth of spirit. Sabotage the broadcast, defile the faithful with blood, and we will let you out.

New Deluxe Catalog: PROJECT BONEYARD

The new Project Boneyard Deluxe Catalog is now available.

  • This Catalog is filled with 10 pages of new exclusive cosmetic items for your own self expression.

    [/*]

  • Unlock the Deluxe Catalog using Murkoff Coins, earned by completing the Onboarding Catalog, other Deluxe Catalogs, or they can be purchased in the Murkoff In-Game Store.

    [/*]

  • Acquire Stamps by completing Trials and Tasks, then use the Stamps to obtain the Deluxe Catalog items.

    [/*]

  • As a reminder, the Deluxe Catalogs are available permanently. Unlock items at your own pace.

    [/*]

Introducing Community Event: BLOOD DRIVE

Blood Drive season is upon us. Blood Extractors have been installed in multiple Trial Environments. Reagents are strongly encouraged to donate generously. Within Blood Drive Trials, a set minimum donation will be required before Reagents are permitted to leave. Be cooperative, give until it hurts.

Blood Drive is a community-wide event. Murkoff requires a substantial supply of blood for an upcoming project, and every contribution helps advance the collective goal. As the community reaches new milestones, additional rewards will be unlocked for all participating Reagents!

Please note that a minimum personal contribution is required to qualify for claiming event rewards.

Variator “BLOOD EXTRACTION” - Use Blood Extractors found in the Trial to donate blood. Each donation permanently reduces your maximum health for the rest of the Trial.

Using a Blood Extractor at Introductory/Standard difficulty provides +1 blood sample. Using a Blood Extractor at Intensive difficulty provides +2 blood samples. Using a Blood Extractor at Psychosurgery difficulty provides +3 blood samples.

New Limited-Time Catalog: BLOOD DRIVE

A brand new Limited-Time Catalog is available for the duration of the Blood Drive Community Event.

  • Players can spend their acquired Event Tokens in the Catalog to unlock exclusive rewards.

    [/*]

  • Once the Blood Drive Event concludes on August 25th at 9:59am ET, the Catalog will be removed and any unused Event Tokens will be forfeited. Be sure to spend your Tokens before the end of the event.

    [/*]

  • NEW: The final page of the Event Catalog now features an infinitely repurchasable Murkoff Box. Spend Event Tokens to receive a bundle of rewards, including XP, Stamps, and a random cosmetic item.

    [/*]

New Ex-Pop: THE BITER

This update introduces Reagents to our newest member of the experimental population, The Biter. These psycho-sadists, former forced labor inmates incapacitated through acts of self-mutilation as protest, have been physically repaired and mentally destroyed by Murkoff’s doctors and scientists.

Arms removed to prevent further self-harm, Biters are universal sadists, still capable of grievous harm with their mechanically enforced jaws. Though Biters are kept chained by the neck for safety, Reagents should approach with caution, as their augmented legs gift them with unexpected velocity. Biters will be featured in Locksock the Warden, Bribe the Judges, and Cancel the Broadcast Trials for the time being before they are ushered into any other Trials.

New Reagent Rig & Knife Customization

Reagents can now customize the appearance of their favorite Rigs. Access the Mirror in your Personal Cell and navigate to the Rigs menu to personalize their look. New customization options can be unlocked through Catalogs and by completing Mastery Tasks.

Imposters can now customize the appearance of their Knife from their customization menu. New Knife skins can be earned through Catalogs and by completing Mastery Tasks.

New Loadout Presets

Save up to 3 different loadouts and switch between them instantly before starting a Trial. Prepare specialized builds and adapt to any challenge with ease.

New Mastery Tasks

Prove your dedication to Murkoff by completing the new Mastery Tasks. Conquer each challenge to unlock the prestigious variant customizations for the Knife and for every Rig.

New Hint System

A new Hint System has been added to assist both new and returning Reagents!

At any time during a Trial, press the “Display Objective” button to display a hint and a visual marker related to your current Trial objective. This feature can be disabled in the Settings Menu.

Escalation Therapy 2.0

The therapy continues to evolve. Take part in endless escalating Trials or challenge yourself with a new themed Weekly Escalation. Compete for a place on the new Escalation Leaderboards and see how you measure up against the facility’s finest Reagents. How much pain can you endure?

New Weekly Escalations

  • Participate in new themed Escalation runs built around unique gameplay modifiers.

    [/*]

  • Every player faces the exact same sequence of Trials and Variators, with only the loadout choices remaining random.

    [/*]

  • Push as far as you can and compare your performance against other Reagents on the leaderboard.

    [/*]

  • A new Escalation Weekly Theme begins every week on Tuesday at 10:00 AM ET, at which point the leaderboard is reset.

    [/*]

  • The first thematic is HARDCORE: “Damage causes permanent health loss and persists between Trials. Syringes are unavailable, and there are no respawns in solo play.”

    [/*]

Refreshed Endless Therapy

  • It's time for a fresh start. With the launch of Escalation Therapy 2.0, all previous Escalation Therapy progress has been reset, including previous peak records and active save files.

    [/*]

  • Your previous best peak has not been lost and can still be viewed in your Personal Records through the radio in your cell.

    [/*]

  • This reset ensures a fair competitive environment for the new leaderboards and removes legacy progress achieved through previous save file exploits.

    [/*]

  • In Endless Escalation, reaching Trial 21 and beyond introduces an additional challenge: maximum health loss becomes persistent between Trials.

    [/*]

Introducing Leaderboards for Escalation

  • Compete against other Reagents and earn your place among the facility's elite. Escalation Leaderboards rank players based on their peak Trial reached, with total run time used as a tiebreaker.

    [/*]

  • Only your best run is recorded. Future runs will not replace your leaderboard position unless you surpass your previous peak.

    [/*]

  • There is a leaderboard for both the Weekly Escalation and Endless Escalation.

    [/*]

  • Leaderboard Eligibility:

    • Players who start a new Escalation run are eligible for leaderboard placement.

      [/*]

    • Players who join an ongoing run and were not present at the start of that run are not eligible for leaderboard placement.

      [/*]

    • Players who begin a run but miss more than two Trials before rejoining lose their leaderboard eligibility. This applies to both ongoing runs and resumed save files.

      [/*]
    [/*]

New Savegames Restrictions

To preserve the integrity of Escalation Therapy, we have updated how save files are handled:

  • Only the host now carries the Escalation save file. Clients can no longer continue a run independently.

    [/*]

  • Progress is only saved upon successfully completing a Trial.

    [/*]

  • If all players quit, disconnect, or fail during a Trial, the run is failed and the savegame is voided.

    [/*]

  • Players still have a 5-minute grace period to rejoin an ongoing Escalation run after an unexpected disconnect.

    [/*]

  • These changes are intended to prevent save file propagation across the player population, ensuring that Escalation remains a challenge that must be earned rather than shared.

    [/*]

Matchmaking changes

  • Players using Group Finder with Join-in-Progress enabled will only be matched into Escalation runs between Trial #1 and Trial #5.

    [/*]

  • When joining a group that is still in the lobby, the group leader may still resume a saved Escalation run regardless of its current progress.

    [/*]

  • These changes help maintain the progression and competitive integrity of Escalation runs while preserving the ability for friends to continue their existing saves together.

    [/*]

Invasion 2.0

We're reimagining Invasion around its core fantasy: Reagents are prey, and the hunt is constant.

Imposters exist to disrupt progress, create uncertainty, and apply pressure where it hurts most throughout the Trial.

In this updated iteration, survival depends on control rather than confrontation. Reagents must rely on their tools to slow pursuit, create opportunities to escape, and use stealth to avoid detection whenever possible.

Imposters, in turn, are more resilient and better equipped to interfere. However, success still depends on patience, positioning, timing, and strategy.

There's a lot to cover, so let's dive in!

Introducing Imposter Loadout

An Imposter is more than a blade. Equip specialized Gadgets to track, disrupt, and hunt your prey.

Imposters now have access to a dedicated Loadout System, allowing them to customize their approach before entering a Trial. Gadgets can be purchased from Dorris using Vouchers and equipped through the new Imposter Loadout Menu.

Available Gadgets:

  • MIMIC - Assume the appearance of a Reagent. Become quieter while moving and preparing a Stab. Hold the fake item to blend in and remain concealed from pings.

    [/*]

  • NEUROSHOCK - Projectile that briefly disrupts a Reagent and disables their rig. Disruption duration scales based on the distance traveled before impact.

    [/*]

  • STIM - Inject a powerful stimulant to temporarily increase speed, stamina, and gain projectile immunity.

    [/*]

  • STEEL TRAP - Deploy a trap that briefly immobilizes any Reagent caught in it.

    [/*]

  • MOTION SENSOR - Deployable device that detects nearby Reagent movement within range.

    [/*]

  • EX-POP BAIT - Throw to lure an Ex-Pop to patrol the impact area.

    [/*]

New Struggle Minigame

Stabbing now initiates a STRUGGLE between the Imposter and the Reagent.

  • Imposter: Mash to inflict as much damage as possible.

    [/*]

  • Reagent: Mash to resist the attack and reduce incoming damage.

    [/*]

A Reagent's remaining health directly influences the outcome. The more injured a Reagent is, the harder it becomes to survive the encounter.

With the introduction of STRUGGLES, Reagents can now actively resist an Imposter's attack. As a result, bottles and bricks can no longer be used for an instant counter while held in inventory.

New Imposter Night Vision

Imposters now have access to their own Night Vision. Unlike the Reagents’ Night Vision, its effectiveness is limited allowing darkness to become a stronger stealth element for Reagents while still giving Imposters a way to track targets and navigate in low-light environments. This creates a more tense predator/prey dynamic during encounters.

Imposter Night Vision drains battery rapidly and does not recharge over time. To restore it, Imposters must retreat to an Insertion Gate. Use it carefully and only when necessary.

Imposters Changes

The Imposter experience has been extensively reworked to support the new hunt-focused gameplay.

  • Slash damage reduced to 25 (previously 33).

    [/*]

  • Cooldown between Slashes reduced to 1.5s (previously 3s). While the cooldown is active, Imposters are limited to walking and cannot run.

    [/*]

  • Added BACKSTAB, a new attack that instantly kills a Reagent. BACKSTAB bypasses the STRUGGLE minigame entirely and cannot be countered. Unlock this new Imposter Chem through Barlow.

    [/*]

  • Nearby Reagents now display a red overhead indicator showing their name and health. This indicator disappears when the Reagent moves too far away, enters darkness, or breaks line of sight behind an obstacle.

    [/*]

  • Imposters no longer impersonate a random Reagent by default. To gain this ability, equip the new MIMIC Gadget in your Loadout. MIMIC also provides additional benefits.

    [/*]

  • Stabs no longer kill outright and now place the Reagent into a downed state.

    [/*]

  • The group widget is now permanently visible while in Camera View, displaying the status of other Imposters, including whether they are invading or in-camera/spectating.

    [/*]

  • Reduced score penalties from Reagent projectiles and Rigs. Scoring values have been rebalanced to support the new gameplay systems and Gadgets.

    [/*]

  • In a situation where 2 Imposters can Invade at once (3v3, 3v4, 4v4), they will now deploy together at the start of an Invasion rather than entering one after another.

    [/*]

  • Each Imposter now has an independent respawn timer. One Imposter's death no longer affects the respawn time of another.

    [/*]

  • The “Imitate” Imposter Chem has been removed and reworked into the MIMIC Gadget. All Vouchers and Permanent Upgrade Tokens previously spent on Imitate have been reimbursed.

    [/*]

  • A new “Backstab” Imposter Chem has been added and unlocks the ability to perform a backstab.

    [/*]

  • Using a Gadget automatically re-equips your Knife, allowing you to quickly resume the hunt.

    [/*]

  • In-camera ping time reduced to 5s (was 10s).

    [/*]

  • Imposters no longer have a timer when they are deployed at the final phase of a Trial (During the Reagent’s “Exit the Trial” objective). They also don’t have the retire when incapacitating or killing a Reagent during this phase.

    [/*]

  • Imposters can now freely relocate using Insertion Gates during the Reagents' “Exit the Trial” objective. During this phase, there are no respawn timers. Using an Insertion Gate will immediately redeploy the Imposter through another gate near the shuttle doors.

    [/*]

  • Imposters can now leave an Invasion at any time. Imposters receive a notification when all players in a group reach A+ grade. In group play, the Group Leader can trigger the Exit Invasion option from the Pause Menu. When the entire group exits together, all Imposters receive rewards based on their grade and performance. Leaving alone/abandoning an ongoing Invasion will not grant rewards.

    • In solo play, Exit Invasion always grants rewards based on performance.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Imposters can make changes to their Loadout directly when in the camera view or spectating.

    [/*]

  • Active invasion time now changes according to the total amount of Imposters in the Trial.

    • 1 Imposter: 5 minutes

      [/*]

    • 2 Imposters: 3 minutes

      [/*]

    • 3-4 Imposters: 2 minutes

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Imposters spend less time spectating/in-cameras between deployments, as they no longer lose health as rapidly as before unless they are killed during their round.

    [/*]

Dev Comment: We've reworked Imposters to better fulfill their role as a constant threat throughout a Trial and equipped them with a variety of Gadgets to support different tactics and hunting strategies. Reagents who stay alert can still evade pursuit and survive encounters, so successful Imposters must rely on timing, stealth, coordination, and carefully planned ambushes rather than brute force. The new tools provide additional counterplay against skilled Reagents, creating a more balanced and engaging predator-versus-prey dynamic for both sides.

Reagents Changes

Reagents have been reworked to focus on survival, disruption, and escape rather than direct confrontation.

  • Reagents now deal minimal damage to Imposters. Tools are intended for disruption and delaying pursuit, not eliminating Imposters.

    [/*]

  • Stunlocking or burst damage strategies using projectiles are no longer viable against Imposters.

    [/*]

  • Getting slashed now triggers a flinch reaction instead of a full body interruption, allowing Reagents to continue moving and fleeing immediately after being hit.

    [/*]

  • Exit Shuttle doors now open automatically once the final objective is completed. Calling the shuttle is no longer required.

    [/*]

  • Ping System has been refactored: Reagents can now always ping Imposters, rather than only after an Imposter has been revealed (using Knife). However, Imposters using the MIMIC gadget cannot be pinged while holding a fake item, allowing them to blend in as apparent allies.

    [/*]

  • Reworked Invasion scoring to reduce penalties and provide greater rewards for surviving an Invasion.

    [/*]

  • Jammer Rig now inflicts Electric Disruption instead of Vomiting to Imposters. The effect is now applied instantly rather than after a delay.

    [/*]

Dev Comment: We've reworked the Reagent experience to be more accessible to all types of players, providing greater opportunities to recover from mistakes, learn the mechanics, and improve over time. Reagent tools are now focused on stealth, survival, and delaying pursuers rather than direct confrontation. While Imposters can still be disrupted, repeatedly attacking them is no longer intended to be a reliable strategy. Success comes from using your tools wisely, staying hidden, and creating opportunities to escape.

Invasion Mode Maps

Invasion Trial Maps have been reworked to improve the overall flow.

  • Trial layouts are now more open, with fewer blocked doors, padlocks, and dead ends to support smoother movement and pursuit.

    [/*]

  • Invasion Trial selection has been adjusted to remove maps with heavy choke points.

    [/*]

  • All Trials remain invadable with Global Invasion (Trials played from Genesis/Events with Invasion set to “Allow” or “Friends only”).

    [/*]

Invasion General Changes

  • Players can no longer quit and rejoin a Trial once an Invasion has started. This applies to both Reagents and Imposters. Any player who leaves - intentionally or otherwise - cannot re-enter the same match.

    [/*]

  • Cross-team communication has been added during Invasions, allowing players to communicate with opponents:

    • Open Microphone: Press B to toggle between team-only and global voice.
